resources.string: Writes status, logs and a car check to the HSM-REPORTS folder on the USB drive while it is plugged in. It starts now and continues after every restart until you turn it off. Serial numbers, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi addresses, network names and passwords are removed. A USB drive must be inserted to turn this on.
Stops writing to the USB drive. Reports already on it are kept.
No USB drive is mounted. Insert a USB drive first.
Recording to the HSM-REPORTS folder on the USB drive.
Recording is off. Reports already on the USB drive were kept.
Reads this unit and checks what limits HMG-Seogaemo: firmware, Wi-Fi hardware, other packages, native libraries and each module. It changes nothing and can take about a minute.
Turn recording on while you test a problem, then send the HSM-REPORTS folder from the USB drive.
